items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Oh, yeah. Well, there was Walter Beatty... Especially Walter Beatty. He was about one of the cleverest that they ever had at the Hoofer's Club.

ctx.x: Well, what other members of the Hoofer's Club? You had mentioned Tip, Tap and Toe. And I remember you recalling a --
Oh, yeah. Well, there was Walter Beatty.
